questions.stem: What is the correct order of the normal phases of wound healing?

options.label: A
options.text: Proliferative phase -> Haemostatic phase -> Inflammatory phase -> Remodelling phase

options.label: B
options.text: Haemostatic phase -> Inflammatory phase -> Proliferative phase -> Remodelling phase

options.label: C
options.text: Destructive phase -> Proliferative phase -> Remodelling phase -> Inflammatory phase

options.label: D
options.text: Remodelling phase -> Proliferative phase -> Destructive phase -> Inflammatory phase
